verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a work-management SaaS like ClickUp, but the evidence pack never documents a ClickUp export feature or any open export formats. The Public API and MCP server are developer building blocks for reading data, not a data-export capability. The Asana and Jira importers move data into ClickUp, the opposite direction.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
